masteries.name: Bicheon
masteries.description: You will soar high into the sky mastering swords. This swordmanship is very moderate and powerful.

masteries.name: Heuksal
masteries.description: Heuksalchangbeop is the spearmanship of the heuksalmun. It is the result of a comprehensive survey of various spearmanships.

masteries.name: Pacheon
masteries.description: The Secret Archery is so powerful it breaks even the sky. The skill is very graceful and militant.

masteries.name: Cold
masteries.description: Hanbingmyeongong is a Force skill which uses the energy of ice. So you can freeze the enemy instantaneously and effectively.

masteries.name: Lightning
masteries.description: Pungroibigong is a Force skill which uses the energy of lightning. so you can give electric pain to the enemy.

masteries.name: Fire
masteries.description: Hwaryeongsingong is a Force skill which uses the energy of fire. So you can burn the enemy.

masteries.name: Force
masteries.description: Gihyeoldaebeop is not a killing skill to harm people. But a healing skill to save lives.

masteries.name: Warrior
masteries.description: The Warrior class is strong and effective for short-distance attacks based on their physical strength and power.It also wears heavy armor without any discomfort which enables them to demonstrate the stronger ability in physical attacks and defenses than any other classes do.

masteries.name: Wizard
masteries.description: Wizards understand the four basic elements of the world that are hidden in the nature: Earth, Water, Fire, and Air. They uses their knowledge to mix this power of the four elements to create strong magical attacks when they subdue the enemy.

masteries.name: Rogue
masteries.description: They balance the world by quietly terminating their opponents. They are experts at making surprise attacks from a long distance hiding itself in the dark and using dagger's dripped in poison to give the final blow.

masteries.name: Warlock
masteries.description: Warlocks are a dark class. They are known for placing curses on their enemies which literally tortures opponents till the end. These curses also gradually reduce the power of their enemies, eventually paralyze them and confuse them. They can use similar powers of the Wizard's to directly attack the enemies.

masteries.name: Bard
masteries.description: Bards assist party members and allies with music which produces various effects. The music that Bards play not only gives allies the self confidence that they can win against any enemies but also provides better abilities and strength. They have further deveolped these skills to confuse their enemies and hurt them. Through a musical performance an ensemble of Bards will give a group the power to defeat their enemies.

masteries.name: Cleric
masteries.description: Clerics borrow God's ability to cure others, free them from pain, and bless them with power so that they will have easier time defeating the enemies. The will to protect themselves from evil and resurrect allies is found within the Cleric.

skills.name: Strike Smash
skills.description: Swing your sword to inflict great damage to the enemy.
skills.study: A hard sword strike. Rather than using the force, this skill utilizes physical might and is dependent on grip. It is the most basic skill through which the other force-enhanced sword skills build upon

skills.name: Stab Smash
skills.description: Thrust your sword to inflict great damage to the enemy.
skills.study: Thrusts the sword at the opponent's heart. Only one who has enough gripping power through their training can use this skill because he or she must thrust the sword with one hand.

skills.name: Crosswise Smash
skills.description: Swing your sword twice to inflict damage to the enemy.
skills.study: This is the first level of the skill of using infusing their inner force within the sword. The user is able to focus the force into their wrists and arms, enabling them to protect themselves and to perform a strong cross-shaped maneuver of great power.

skills.name: Flying Stone Smash
skills.description: Swing your sword twice to inflict damage to the enemy.
skills.study: A skill that increases damage by using the body's turning force and inner energy. Attacks the enemy by spinning the body, increasing the damage of the attack.

skills.name: Illusion Chain
skills.description: Applies 3 combo attack.
skills.study: "The first skill in the Chain Sword Attack Series; the Illusion Chain strikes the enemy 3 times rapidly. It is called the Illusion chain because from the opponents' perspective it appears that they are fighting illusions."

skills.name: Blood Chain
skills.description: Applies 4 combo attack.
skills.study: "The second skill of Chain Sword Attack Series; Blood Chain strikes the enemy 4 times rapidly. It is called Blood Chain because the opponent will fall in a spray of blood."

skills.name: Billow Chain
skills.description: Applies 5 combo attack.
skills.study: "In the second skill of Chain Sword Attack Series; Billow chain strikes the enemy 5 times rapidly. The enemy falls under a wave of blood."

skills.name: Ascension Chain
skills.description: Applies 4 combo attack.
skills.study: The third skill of Chain Sword Attack Series, the Ascension chain strikes the enemy four times rapidly while jumping. The skill owes its name to the fact that whoever practices this skill appears to be ascending into the sky.

skills.name: Heaven Chain
skills.description: Applies 5 combo attack.
skills.study: "The third skill of Chain Sword Attack Series; Heaven chain strikes the enemy five times in a large movement. The skill is called Heaven for its grace."

skills.name: Lightning Chain
skills.description: Applies 6 combo attack.
skills.study: Lightning Chain is a skill that strikes the enemy 6 times. It is called lightning because the skill is so quick it is difficult to see. It is said that it is so delicate and accurate that the skill can be used to cut a willow tree into pieces.

skills.name: Castle Shield
skills.description: Increase the physical defense power by infusing energy into the shield.
skills.study: The first skill of the Shield Protection series, it is as effective at blocking attacks as a fortress placed in an open field.

skills.name: Mountain Shield
skills.description: Increase the physical block rate by infusing energy into the shield.
skills.study: The second skill of the Shield Protection series, it blocks every attack from up above or below like a great mountain soaring high into the sky.

skills.name: Ironwall Shield
skills.description: Increase the physical defense power by infusing energy into the shield.
skills.study: The third skill of the Shield Protection series, it creates a huge shield like an iron wall.

skills.name: Giant Shield
skills.description: Increase the physical block rate by infusing energy into the shield.
skills.study: The fourth skill of the Shield Protection series, it forms an enormous defensive shield like a huge castle.

skills.name: Soul Cut Blade
skills.description: Swing your sword and launch the blade force at the distant enemy.
skills.study: As an applied skill of Strike n' smash, Blood Blade Force causes the blood of the dead enemies to flow after blade force. It launches the energy of the blade at the enemies in front.

skills.name: Evil Cut Blade
skills.description: Swing your sword faster and launch the blade force at the very distant enemy.
skills.study: The skill is called Soul blade force meaning that the souls of the dead enemies provide a force to the sword. It launches the strong blade force to the opposing enemies .

skills.name: Devil Cut Blade
skills.description: Swing your sword fast twice and launch the blade force at the enemy.
skills.study: With the blade force, it destroys even demons. Two bursts of blade force are launched simultaneously.

skills.name: Demon Cut Blade
skills.description: Swing your sword fast twice and launch the blade force at the enemy.
skills.study: Demons of death collaborate at the edge of the sword, and the skill discharges 2 consecutive sword energy attacks.

skills.name: Blood Blade Force
skills.description: Destroy the enemy with your force infused sword.
skills.study: A skill that involves swinging the sword like a blooming flower. In the precise moment that the opponent lowers their guard, one's body immediately drops and strikes upwards at an angle.

skills.name: Soul Blade Force
skills.description: Destroy the enemy in front with your force infused sword.
skills.study: Slices enemies nearby via a fast spin-attack of the warrior with an apperance similar to that of a flower spreading its petals.

skills.name: Demon Blade Force
skills.description: Destroy the enemy in front with your force infused sword.
skills.study: A sword strike like a dragon soaring into the sky. Strikes the enemy vertically, and hard.

skills.name: Flower Bloom Blade
skills.description: Runs towards the fallen enemy and strikes him again.
skills.study: The first skill of the the Killing Heaven Blade Series is the Flower Bloom Blade. One cuts down the fallen opponent swiftly with two hands.

skills.name: Flower Bud Blade
skills.description: Jumps and strikes the fallen enemy.
skills.study: "The second skill in the Killing Heaven Blade Series; the Flower Bud Blade,cuts down the enemy swiftly twice with two hands and then twists the blade inside of the body of the fallen enemy."

skills.name: Dragon Sore Blade
skills.description: Strikes the fallen enemy twice very powerfully.
skills.study: "The third skill in the Killing Heaven Blade Series; the Dragon Sore Blade chops the fallen enemy swiftly twice. It is so powerful that it can destroy even the devils who trouble the world."

skills.name: Snake Sword Dance
skills.description: Controls the sword and pierces through a number of distant enemies.
skills.study: The first skill in the Sword Dance Series. It is dubbed Snake because it breaks through crowds of enemies like a snake covered with blood.

skills.name: Petal Sword Dance
skills.description: Controls many swords and attacks many enemies at the same time.
skills.study: The second skill in the Sword Dance Series. It is called Petal because three wobbling blades fall down on the enemy like flower petals .

skills.name: Typhoon Sword Dance
skills.description: Controls the sword and pierces through a number of distant enemies.
skills.study: "The third skill in the Sword Dance Series; it is called Typhoon because 4 swords fly fast, creating vicious winds."

skills.name: Glacial Flame Bicheon Force
skills.description: Decreases the physical defense power of the shield and increases the physical attack power for a period of time.
skills.study: The first skill in the Bicheon Force series, Glacial Flame uses the energy of ice and flames to lower the defensive power of the shield and increase offensive power.

skills.name: Storm Bicheon Force
skills.description: Decreases the physical defense power of the shield and increases the physical attack power for a period of time.
skills.study: The second skill in the Bicheon Force series, Storm uses the energy of the wind and the clouds to lower the defensive power of the shield and increase offensive power.

skills.name: Banshee Bicheon Force
skills.description: Decreases the physical defense power of the shield and increases the physical attack power for a period of time.
skills.study: The third skill in the Bicheon Force series, Banshee uses the energy of the spirits and the ghosts to significantly lower the defensive power of the shield and grants the power of resistance to evil.

skills.name: Summit & Depth Bicheon Force
skills.description: Decreases the physical defense power of the shield and increases the physical attack power for a period of time.
skills.study: The fourth skill in the Bicheon Force series, Summit & Depth uses the energy of the mountains and the seas to lower the defensive power of the shield by about half and grants the power of raging billows.

skills.name: Shield Protection
skills.description: Permanently increses the blocking ratio of the shield.
skills.study: A physical shield has a limited resistence and tends to be easily broken when struck by attacks of inner Force. You have to infuse your shield with your own inner force in order to protect youself from such an attack. This skill allows you to remain in a constant state of protection by suddenly injecting inner force into your shield at the precise moment an enemy hits you, and is appropriately named Shield Protection.

skills.name: Wolf Bite Spear
skills.description: Holds the spear with two hands and applies the piercing attack at the enemy in front.
skills.study: It pierces through all nearby enemies with the same ferocity as a wolf biting its prey. To exercise this skill, you have to thrust the spear towards the enemy with all of your might.

skills.name: Waning Moon Spear
skills.description: Holds the spear with one hand and thrust it and applies the piercing attack at the enemy in front.
skills.study: Lean your body backwards and thrust though with your shoulder at the enemy holding the spear with one hand. This is the second move of Annihilating Blade. It is powerful and ferocious. It is called Waning Moon.

skills.name: Yuhon Spear
skills.description: Spins the body and applies the piercing attack at the enemy in front.
skills.study: The word Yuhon refers to a circle of beautiful jade. You use centripetal force in swinging the spear and piercing the enemy. It looks like a Yuhon and so it has been named such. It is the third move of Annihilating Blade Series.

skills.name: Lightning Bird Spear
skills.description: Sway back and thrust, dealing two piercing attacks in the front line.
skills.study: The motion of the user charging at the enemy looks like a hungry hawk flying at its prey. This is the fourth skill of Annihilating Blade Series.

skills.name: Bloody Fan Storm
skills.description: Increase magical defense power by creating wind energy with the spear.
skills.study: Spin the spear hard to generate a bloody storm. The bloody storm will spread like a fan.

skills.name: Bloody Wolf Storm
skills.description: Increase magical block rate by creating wind energy with the spear.
skills.study: Spin the spear hard to generate a bloody storm. The bloody storm will sprint like a wolf.

skills.name: Bloody Snake Storm
skills.description: Increase magical defense power by creating wind energy with the spear.
skills.study: Spin the spear hard to generate a bloody storm. The bloody storm will thrash about like a snake.

skills.name: Bloody Demon Storm
skills.description: Increase magical block rate by creating wind energy with the spear.
skills.study: Creates bloody storm by spinning the spear. The bloody storm gallops like a horse, and spreads violently.

skills.name: Dancing Demon Spear
skills.description: Sweep your spear in a large motion to attack many enemies simultaneously in front.
skills.study: The first skill of the Heuksal Spearmanship, it destroys all of the enemies in like a dancing demon.

skills.name: Jade Breaking Spear
skills.description: Sweep your spear twice to apply double attacks to the enemies in front.
skills.study: The second skill of the Heuksal Spearmanship involves two hard sweeps strong enough to break solid jade formed over hundreds of years.

skills.name: Spirit Crash Spear
skills.description: Sweep your spear in a large, powerful motion to attack many enemies simultaneously in front.
skills.study: The third skill of the Heuksal Spearmanship involves a technique that can pulverise even spirits without bodies. You tear the air infront of you into shreds.

skills.name: Windless Spear
skills.description: Sweep your spear twice in a large motion to attack the enemies twice in the front line.
skills.study: The fourth skill of the Heuksal Spear Series, it attacks the enemy like a dancing red leaf.

skills.name: Soul Spear - Move
skills.description: Swing the spear to hit the enemy hard and stun him.
skills.study: The first skill of the Soul Departs Spear Series is called Move. It is lethal to the extent that it shakes the opponent's soul.

skills.name: Soul Spear - Truth
skills.description: Strikes down hard giving great damage to the enemy and stunning him.
skills.study: The second skill of the Soul Departs Spear Series is called Truth. With a blow of inner force, it damages the enemy's soul.

skills.name: Soul Spear - Soul
skills.description: Strikes down twice hard giving great damage to the enemy and stunning him.
skills.study: The third skill of Soul Departs Spear Series is called Soul. The enemy receives blows of inner force until his soul is destroyed, and separated from his body.

skills.name: Soul Spear - Emperor
skills.description: Strikes down twice hard giving great damage to the enemy and stunning him.
skills.study: The fourth skill of the Soul Departs series is called Emperor. Strike hard and wield left and right to overpower the enemy's body and soul.

skills.name: Ghost Spear - Petal
skills.description: Swings the spear wide to attack the enemies nearby.
skills.study: The first skill of the Ghost Spear Attack Series. It is graceful and powerful. It gives the impression of picking a tiny flower from an imposing cliff.

skills.name: Ghost Spear - Prince
skills.description: Swings the spear wide to attack the enemies nearby and force them backward.
skills.study: The skill is moderate, and noble like a prince. It is slightly different to the traditional Heuksalmun ways. It is the second skill of the Ghost Spear Attack Series.

skills.name: Ghost Spear - Mars
skills.description: Swings the spear wide to attack the enemies nearby and force them backward.
skills.study: Like a heavenly fighter descending from the sky, the skill is noble and overpowering. It is the third skill of the Ghost Spear Attack Series.

skills.name: Chain Spear - Tiger
skills.description: Applies 3 combo attack.
skills.study: The first skill of the Chain Spear Attack Series is called Tiger. It strikes the enemy with an agile and strong triple combo attack. It is based on the basic skills of the Heuksal Spearmanship.

skills.name: Chain Spear - Nachal
skills.description: Applies 4 combo attack.
skills.study: The second skill of the Chain Spear Attack Series is a move called Nachal. Like the spear that Nachal wields, it breaks down everything standing in the way, striking four times continuously.

skills.name: Chain Spear - Shura
skills.description: Applies 5 combo attack. Attacks all the enemies in front with the last blow.
skills.study: The second skill of the Chain Spear Attack Series is a move called Shura. Like the spear that Sura swings, it is dazzling as if dozens of spears are used. It strikes the enemy 5 times in succession and finally finishes with the Jade breaking spear

skills.name: Chain Spear - Pluto
skills.description: Applies 4 combo attack.
skills.study: The third skill of the Chain Spear Attack Series is a move called Pluto. Like the king of Pluto striking down, it has a great attack. It strikes four times continuously.

skills.name: Chain Spear - Dragon
skills.description: Applies 6 combo attack.
skills.study: The third skill of the Chain Spear Attack Series is a move called Dragons. As if several dragons are assaulting the enemies, it strikes the vulnerable points of the enemies in several directions, striking 6 times continuously. It is a powerful high level of martial art.

skills.name: Flying Dragon - Flow
skills.description: Hurl your spear at the enemies in front to give them a piercing attack.
skills.study: The first skill in the Flying Dragon Series is called Flow, in that it flows smoothly like a river.

skills.name: Flying Dragon - Fly
skills.description: Hurl your spear at the enemies in front to give them a powerful piercing attack.
skills.study: The second skill in the Flying Dragon Series is called Fly, in that it seems to fly in the air.

skills.name: Flying Dragon - Bless
skills.description: Hurl your spear at the enemies in front to give them a powerful piercing attack.
skills.study: The third skill of the Flying Dragon Series appears as if a dragon soars high up to the sky.

skills.name: Cheolsam Force
skills.description: Permanently increases the maximum HP point by a certain amount.
skills.study: The Heuksal Sect knew well of their weakness in defensive skills so they trained in peripheral forces to make up for that. Adopting the Cheolsa Force and Cheolpo Force from external sources, finally they created their own technique called the Cheolsam Force. It is a method of strengthening the body, especially the skin and muscles.

skills.name: Anti Devil Bow - Missile
skills.description: Launches the arrow of high hitting ratio with all might.
skills.study: The levels of the Anti Devil Bow Series are divided by how you infuse the force into an arrow and maintain it. First train the Missile skill of Anti Devil Bow Series by infusing the force into the arrowhead to increase the attack power.

skills.name: Anti Devil Bow - Wave
skills.description: Launches the arrow of higher hitting ratio with all might.
skills.study: The second skill of the Anti Devil Bow Series, infuses the force into the arrowhead and the pole of an arrow so as to increase the attack power and speed. It is called Wave.

skills.name: Anti Devil Bow - Steel
skills.description: Launches the arrow of the highest hitting ratio with all might.
skills.study: The third skill of the Anti Devil Bow Series forges a long belt of force around the arrow so as to give a critical attack to the enemy. It is called Steel.

skills.name: Anti Devil Bow - Strike
skills.description: Launches the arrow of the highest hitting ratio with all might.
skills.study: The fourth skill of the Anti Devil Bow Series launches an arrow by quickly transferring powerful inner energy.

skills.name: 2 Arrow Combo
skills.description: Launches two arrows in relay.
skills.study: Arrow Combo Attack Series begins from training to shoot two arrows in succession. Draw two arrows at one time and shoot them quickly in series. It is called 2 Arrow combo.

skills.name: 3 Arrow Combo
skills.description: Launches three arrows fast in relay.
skills.study: Disciples who have mastered the 2 Arrow combo move on to train on the 3 Arrow combo. Draw three arrows in one move and shoot them quickly in series.

skills.name: 4 Arrow Combo
skills.description: Launches four arrows faster in relay.
skills.study: Disciples who have mastered the 3 Arrow combo move to the 4 Arrow combo. Draw four arrows at one move and shoot them fast in succession. Its speed must be the same of 3 Arrow combo.

skills.name: 5 Arrow Combo
skills.description: Launches five arrows faster in relay.
skills.study: The disciples who have mastered the 4 Arrow Combo begin to train the 5 Arrow Combo. Inserts energy to each 5 arrows and then shoots them consecutively.

skills.name: White Hawk Summon
skills.description: Increases the hitting ratio by summoning a white hawk. Usable only when using a bow.
skills.study: The White hawk is merely ordinary, but it serves to distract the enemy's attention so as to lower their chances of dodging.

skills.name: Black Hawk Summon
skills.description: Attacks directly by summoning a black hawk. Usable only when using a bow.
skills.study: Black hawk has more aggressive traits than a white hawk so it can attack the enemy directly and return to the trainer.

skills.name: Blue Hawk Summon
skills.description: Increases the hitting ratio by summoning a blue hawk. Usable only when using a bow.
skills.study: The Blue hawk is caught near the great mountain and trained to distract the enemy's attention. Its intellect is higher than the white hawk.

skills.name: Lightning Hawk Summon
skills.description: Attack the enemies by summoning a lightning hawk. Usable only when using a bow.
skills.study: Lightning Hawk attacks enemies with the powerful energy of lightning.

skills.name: Autumn Wind - Flame
skills.description: Launches a strong arrow which penetrates many enemies in front.
skills.study: If you shoot using the Autumn Wind Arrow, it leaves a trace of flame flowing after it. The first level is called Autumn wind-Flame.

skills.name: Autumn Wind - Snake
skills.description: Launches a strong arrow which penetrates many enemies in front.
skills.study: If you shoot using the Autumn Wind Arrow, it leaves a trace of flame flowing after it. It is differentiated by its degree and the second level is called Autumn wind-Snake.

skills.name: Autumn Wind - Blood
skills.description: Launches a strong arrow which penetrates many enemies in front.
skills.study: As the third move of Autumn Wind Arrow, if you use this, it leaves a trace like a river of blood. It is called Autumn wind-Blood.

skills.name: Autumn Wind - Red
skills.description: Launches a strong arrow which penetrates many enemies in front.
skills.study: The fourth move of Autumn Wind Arrow, the path of the arrow looks like a rainbow.

skills.name: Demon Soul Arrow
skills.description: Launches a long range arrow with all might. Usable only when using a bow.
skills.study: The Demon soul arrow of Pacheon is a powerful skill meaning that the arrows belong to the spirit or demon. This is the first skill of the Pacheon Arrow Series.

skills.name: Bloody Soul Arrow
skills.description: Launches a further range arrow with all might. Usable only when using a bow.
skills.study: Bloody Soul Arrows of Pacheon is a powerful skill meaning that the arrows are made of bloody souls. This is the second skill of Pacheon Arrow Series.

skills.name: Dragon Soul Arrow
skills.description: Launches the farthest range arrow with all might. Usable only when using a bow.
skills.study: Dragon soul arrow is a powerful skill meaning that the soul of a dragon is lying in the arrow. This is the third skill of Pacheon Arrow Series.

skills.name: Berserker Arrow
skills.description: Launches an arrow with a small amount of blasting powder.
skills.study: The first stage of the Explosion Arrow Series is called Berserker arrow. It explodes like a furious god of war.

skills.name: Demon Arrow
skills.description: Launches an arrow with a large amount of blasting powder.
skills.study: The second stage of the Explosion Arrow Series is called Demon Arrow. It explodes like a crazy demon.

skills.name: Devil Arrow
skills.description: Launches a strong arrow with a large amount of blasting powder.
skills.study: The third stage of the Explosion Arrow Series is named Devil Arrow. It explodes like atrocious devils crying deep down in the darkness.

skills.name: Strong Bow - Spirit
skills.description: Launches the strong attack power arrow with a strong string.
skills.study: To pull the string with a strong grip, you have to control your mind first. This level of control this is called the Spirit.

skills.name: Strong Bow - Vision
skills.description: Launches the strong attack power arrow with a strong string.
skills.study: To hit the target with a great accuracy, you have be able to observe a wide area. This level of sight this is called Vision.

skills.name: Strong Bow - Craft
skills.description: Launches the strong attack power arrow with a strong string.
skills.study: Those that master this skill can shoot out an arrow powerful enough at the enemy's vulnerable points to knock them down.

skills.name: Mind Bow - Flower
skills.description: Shoots out an arrow that attacks many targets by following the enemy.
skills.study: The First move of the Mind Bow Series, it is called Flower because the two arrows shot look like a flower blooming.

skills.name: Mind Bow - Butterfly
skills.description: Shoots out an arrow that attacks many targets by following the enemy.
skills.study: The Second move of the Mind Bow Series, it is called Butterfly because the three arrows shot look like butterflies scattering.

skills.name: Mind Bow - Swift
skills.description: Shoots out an arrow that attacks many targets by following the enemy.
skills.study: Third move of the Mind Bow Series, it is called Swift because the four arrows shot are too fast to be seen.

skills.name: Mind Concentration
skills.description: Permanently increases the hitting ratio by a certain amount.
skills.study: The basic training of the Pacheon Sect is designed to develop the ability to concentrate and mainly consists of the training of the Mind concentration. Only continuous training and meditation lead you to the final stage of controlling the Heart freely.

skills.name: Ice River Force
skills.description: Makes the enemy get frozen or frostbitten by infusing the force of Ice into the weapon.
skills.study: The first skill of Cold Force Series is named Ice River Force because it looks like a river of ice. The basic martial art of the Hanbing sect, it involves naturally infusing the force of ice into one's weapon.

skills.name: Ice Jade Force
skills.description: Makes the enemy get frozen or frostbitten by infusing the force of Ice into the weapon.
skills.study: The second skill of the Cold Force Series is called Ice Jade Force because it looks like a jade stone made of ice. This is the stage of releasing the infused force.

skills.name: Ice Ocean Force
skills.description: Makes the enemy get frozen or frostbitten by infusing the force of Ice into the weapon.
skills.study: The third skill of Cold Force Series is called Ice Ocean because it looks like an ocean covered with ice. This is the stage of maintaining the flow of infused force for extended periods.

skills.name: Ice Cloud Force
skills.description: Makes the enemy get frozen or frostbitten by infusing the force of Ice into the weapon.
skills.study: The fourth skill of Cold Force Series is called Ice Cloud Force because it is covered with ice like the cold clouds high up heaven. This is the stage of increasing attack power and also protecting your weapon with the force of Ice.

skills.name: Weak Guard of Ice
skills.description: Exercises the Frost Protecting Force to increase the physical resistence.
skills.study: The first skill of Frost Guard Force is the stage of training the body to prepare for adaption into an iced form called Weak Guard. The first stage cannot transform the body into ice but still provides great defensive power.

skills.name: Soft Guard of Ice
skills.description: Exercises the Frost Protecting Force to increase the physical resistence.
skills.study: The second skill of Frost Guard Force is called Soft Guard. It is the stage of actually transforming the body into the iced form.

skills.name: Power Guard of Ice
skills.description: Exercises the Frost Protecting Force to increase the physical resistence.
skills.study: The third skill of Frost Guard Force is called Power Guard. It stops the unnecessary flow of inner force and uses it to form a protecting force but is very draining.

skills.name: Might Guard of Ice
skills.description: Exercises the Frost Protecting Force to increase the physical resistence.
skills.study: The fourth skill of Frost Guard Force is called Might Guard. It protects one's body completely from any harmful attacks by exercising the blocking technique inside and outside of body simultaneously.

skills.name: Cold wave - Arrest
skills.description: Makes distant enemies frostbitten by launching the force of Ice at them.
skills.study: The first skill of Cold Wave Attack Series is called Arrest. It launches the ice crystal generated with the force at the enemy. This is just a basic stage with a low probability of success.

skills.name: Cold wave - Binding
skills.description: Makes distant enemies frostbitten by launching the force of Ice at them.
skills.study: The second skill of Cold Wave Attack Series is called Binding. It launches the ice crystal generated with the force at the enemy. In this stage, the crystal intrudes the enemy's body and affects their flow of force so it has a slightly higher probability of success.

skills.name: Cold wave - Shackle
skills.description: Makes distant enemies frostbitten by launching the force of Ice at them.
skills.study: The third skill of Cold Wave Attack Series is called Shackle. It launches the ice crystal generated with the force at the enemy. In this stage, the crystall intrudes the enemy's body and will be frozen inside of him so it has very high possibility of success.

skills.name: Cold Wave - Freeze
skills.description: Makes distant enemies frostbitten by launching the force of Ice at them.
skills.study: The fourth skill of Cold Wave Attack Series is called Freeze. It shoots an ice crystal made with energy at the enemy, and the crystal melts inside the body freezing the blood inside. Thus it has an extremely high possibility of success.

skills.name: Crystal Wall
skills.description: Absorbs the physical attack by creating the wall of ice.
skills.study: Forms an Frost Wall Series around oneself by using the force of Ice and upgrading its resistance up to that of steel. It is the first skill of the Frost Wall Series technique and is called Crystal Wall.

skills.name: Snow Wall
skills.description: Absorbs the physical attack by creating the wall of ice.
skills.study: Forms a Frost Wall Series that has the extreme force of ice and a great resistance like snow accumulated over a thousand years, It is the second skill of the Frost Wall Series technique and is called Snow Wall.

skills.name: Extreme Wall
skills.description: Absorbs the physical attack by creating the wall of ice.
skills.study: Forms a Frost Wall Series of extreme resistance like ice formed on the tops of great snow covered mountains. It is the third skill of the Frost Wall Series technique and is called Extreme Wall.

skills.name: Iceberg Wall
skills.description: Absorbs the physical attack by creating the wall of ice.
skills.study: This is Iceberg Wall, the fourth move of the Frost Wall Series, that forms a solid ice wall like an iceberg that doesn't melt for ten thousand years.

skills.name: Frost Nova - Wind
skills.description: Makes the enemies get frozen or frostbitten by freezing the ground in front.
skills.study: The first skill of the Frost Nova Series freezes all oncoming enemies like a frost wind is sweeping a vast field.

skills.name: Frost Nova - Woods
skills.description: Makes the enemies get frozen or frostbitten by freezing the ground nearby.
skills.study: The second skill of the Frost Nova Series freezes all nearby enemies like an endless forest.

skills.name: Frost Nova - Storm
skills.description: Makes the enemies get frozen or frostbitten by freezing a broad area of the ground in front.
skills.study: The third skill of the Frost Nova Series freezes all opposing enemies like a cold storm from the northern sea.

skills.name: Snow Storm - Ice shot
skills.description: Gives a far ranged attack of frost trait.
skills.study: The first skill of Snowstorm drops an ice crystal at the enemy and gives a small amount of damage to him.

skills.name: Snow Storm - Ice rain
skills.description: Gives a far ranged zone attack of frost trait.
skills.study: The second skill of Snowstorm drops several ice crystals at a crowd of enemies and inflicts a large amount of damage on them and causing pandemonium.

skills.name: Snow Storm - Double Shot
skills.description: Gives a far ranged attack of frost trait.
skills.study: Third skill of the Snow Storm Series, it shoots condensed ice energy once at the enemy, causing extreme pain.

skills.name: Snow Shield - Novice
skills.description: Portions of damage received will be reduced from MP, and more MP than received damage will be reduced.
skills.study: The first skill of Snow Shield Series, the technique of creating ice energy from the abdomen is learned.

skills.name: Snow Shield - Adept
skills.description: Portions of damage received will be reduced from MP, and more MP than received damage will be reduced.
skills.study: The second skill of the Snow Shield Series, deals with learning an easy method of controlling ice energy without much effort.

skills.name: Snow Shield - Freeze
skills.description: Portions of damage received will be reduced from MP, and more MP than received damage will be reduced.
skills.study: The third skill of the Snow Shield Series, deals with learning how to freeze the damage dealt on the body with ice energy.

skills.name: Snow Shield - Intensify
skills.description: Portions of damage received will be reduced from MP, and more MP than received damage will be reduced.
skills.study: The fourth Skill of the Snow Shield Series, deals with learning how to intensify the ice energy used to deal with damage.

skills.name: Cold Armor
skills.description: Permanently increases the physical resistence by a certain amount.
skills.study: Cold Armor is a technique which uses one's body as a vessel to be filled with Water energy and intensifies it. This vessel cannot be forged with a special mantra but you must consume your Water energy little by little.

skills.name: Thunder Tiger Force
skills.description: Strikes the enemy with electricity, infusing the thunder force into the weapon.
skills.study: The first skill of the Thunder Force Series is called Thunder Tiger meaning that it is a tiger which has a force of thunder. It is the basic martial art of Thunder Force. It is a skill of infusing the force of thunder into the weapon naturally.

skills.name: Thunder Sky Force
skills.description: Strikes the enemy with electricity, infusing the thunder force into the weapon.
skills.study: The second skill of Thunder Force Series is called Thunder Sky meaning that it is a martial art which divides the sky like thunder. It is a skill of exerting out the force infused inside of the weapon.

skills.name: Thunder King Force
skills.description: Strikes the enemy with electricity, infusing the thunder force into the weapon.
skills.study: The third skill of Thunder Force Series is called Thunder King meaning that it has is dignified and majestic like a king. It is a stage of increasing the power of force after finishing the basic trainings.

skills.name: Thunder Dragon Force
skills.description: Strikes the enemy with electricity, infusing the thunder force into the weapon.
skills.study: The fourth skill of Thunder Force Series is called Thunder Dragon meaning that it has the shape of a descending dragon. It is a skill of breaking through obstacles.

skills.name: Must - Piercing Force
skills.description: Force class of damage increases.
skills.study: To master the Piercing Force Series, you have to remove impurity which interrupts the flow of force. This is the stage of Must.

skills.name: Flow - Piercing Force
skills.description: Force class of damage increases.
skills.study: After making the inner force flow smoothly, you have to be able to control the flow. To do that, you have to make way for the flow of force. This is the stage of Flow.

skills.name: Speed - Piercing Force
skills.description: Force class of damage increases.
skills.study: Once the force inside of the body flows smoothly, you should train to increase the speed of the flow. This is the stage of Speed.

skills.name: Force - Piercing Force
skills.description: Force class of damage increases.
skills.study: After training the Piercing Force Series to a certain level, the speed of the flow will quicken and also be able to be controlled at will. This is the stage of Force.

skills.name: Grass Walk - Flow
skills.description: Increases the character's agility a little for a certain amount of time.
skills.study: As the first stage of Flying Over the Grass Walk the skill is smooth and fast like flowing water.

skills.name: Ghost Walk - phantom
skills.description: Moves fast to the selected location in an instant.
skills.study: The first skill of Ghost Walk is trained in short range at first. It is called Phantom meaning that it is scattered like a shadow.

skills.name: Grass Walk - Speed
skills.description: Increases the character's agility a little more for a certain amount of time.
skills.study: The second skill of the Grass Walk Series. It moves fast and freely like the wind, so it is called Speed.

skills.name: Ghost Walk - Shadow
skills.description: Moves fast to the selected location in an instant.
skills.study: The second skill of Ghost Walk is a stage of being able to move a long distance quickly. It is called Shadow because the speed of the skill is such that it leaves the shadow behind.

skills.name: Shock Lion Shout
skills.description: Gives a certain amount of damage to the enemy by interrupting their operation of inner force.
skills.study: The Shock Lion Shout disturbs the enemy's operation of force and gives some damage to them by using a thundering sound.

skills.name: Heaven Lion Shout
skills.description: Gives a certain amount of damage to the enemy by interrupting their operation of inner force.
skills.study: The Heaven Lion Shout generates a big sound to the extent of thundering the sky so the enemies cannot control the flow of force when they heard of it.

skills.name: Earth Lion Shout
skills.description: Gives a certain amount of damage to the enemy by interrupting their operation of inner force.
skills.study: The Earth Lion Shout makes a great sound to the extent of shaking the heaven and earth and reverses the flow of force from toe to head and gives inner damage to them.

skills.name: Power Lion Shout
skills.description: Gives a certain amount of damage to the enemy by interrupting their operation of inner force.
skills.study: The Power Lion Shout deals great inner damage with a sound powerful enough to scatter the energy of the earth.

skills.name: Concentration - 1st
skills.description: Increases temporarily the character's parry ratio for a certain amount of time.
skills.study: The first skill of Concentration technique. It is a stage of concentrating on the opponent and blocking noises on the outside.

skills.name: Concentration - 2nd
skills.description: Increases temporarily the character's parry ratio for a certain amount of time.
skills.study: The second skill of Concentration technique. It is a stage of intensifying all senses to respond instantly to any stimulus on the outside.

skills.name: Concentration - 3rd
skills.description: Increases temporarily the character's parry ratio for a certain amount of time.
skills.study: The third skill of Concentration technique. It is a stage where one has understood the flow of inner force and so is able to respond instantly to any stimulus without having to concentrate.

skills.name: Wolf's Thunderbolt
skills.description: Launches the thunderbolt that applies damage to the enemies around the target.
skills.study: Wolf's Thunderbolt is the first skill in the Thunderbolt Force Series. It symbolizes the flow of force like ten hungry wolves running for their prey.

skills.name: Tiger's Thunderbolt
skills.description: Launches the thunderbolt that applies damage to the enemies around the target.
skills.study: Tiger's Thunderbolt is the second skill in the Thunderbolt Force Series. It symbolizes the flow of force like a hundred fearless tigers stampeding down.

skills.name: Horse's Thunderbolt
skills.description: Launches the thunderbolt that applies damage to the enemies around the target.
skills.study: Horse's Thunderbolt is the third skill in the Thunderbolt Force Series, and appears like a thousand galloping horses.

skills.name: Heaven's Force
skills.description: Permanently increases the dodge ratio by the specified amount.
skills.study: The disciples who want to apply Heaven's Lightning to increase dodge power start to train the Noicheonjigong art. As a basic training of the Thunder Force Mastery, it focuses on refining the form of flowing force and quickening its flow to lighten the body.

skills.name: River Fire force
skills.description: Increases the attack power of Force by infusing the force of Fire into the weapon.
skills.study: The first skill of Fire Force Series is called Fire River because it looks like a flowing fire. It is the basic art of the Fire Force Series. Infuses the force of Fire into one's weapon naturally.

skills.name: Extreme Fire force
skills.description: Increases the attack power of Force by infusing the force of Fire into the weapon.
skills.study: The second skill of Fire Force Series is called Extreme Fire because it looks like a very intese fire. Exerts out the force of Fire inside of the weapon.

skills.name: Poison Fire force
skills.description: Increases the attack power of Force by infusing the force of Fire into the weapon.
skills.study: The third skill of Fire Force Series is called Poisonous Fire. It gives the deadly force of Fire to the enemy.

skills.name: Soul Fire force
skills.description: Increases the attack power of Force by infusing the force of Fire into the weapon.
skills.study: The fourth skill of Fire Force Series is called Fire Soul to mean that the soul of a fire god is put into it. Carries a heat so strong that even demons familiar to the fire of Hell cannot withstand it.

skills.name: Fire Shield - Phoenix
skills.description: Decreases the power of abnormal state by infusing the force into the shield.
skills.study: It is the first skill of the Fire Shield series. The flame over the shield reminded people of a phoenix so the skill was named Bird.

skills.name: Fire Shield - Flower
skills.description: Decreases the power of abnormal state by infusing the force into the shield.
skills.study: It is the second skill of the Fire Shield series. The flame over the shield reminded people of a beautiful flower so the skill was named Flower.

skills.name: Fire Shield - King
skills.description: Decreases the power of abnormal state by infusing the force into the shield.
skills.study: It is the third skill of the Fire Shield series. The intensiveness of the flame could not be compared to anything so the skill was named King.

skills.name: Fire Shield - Emperor
skills.description: Decreases the power of abnormal state by infusing the force into the shield.
skills.study: The flame over the shield displays the majesty of an Emperor who is noble and unapproachable so the skill was named Emperor. It is the fourth skill of Fire Shield Series.

skills.name: Flame body - Wisdom
skills.description: Increases physical damage by burning your own body.
skills.study: The Flame Body Series consists of five skills. The first stage is called Wisdom and is the procedure of transform one's body into a flaming object.

skills.name: Flame body - Power
skills.description: Increases physical damage by burning your own body.
skills.study: The Flame Body Series consists of five skills. The second stage is called Power and is the procedure of magnifying attack power by using one's body transformed into a Flame Object.

skills.name: Flame body - Extreme
skills.description: Increases physical damage by burning your own body.
skills.study: The Flame Body Series consists of five skills. The third stage is called Extreme and is the hard training of setting one's body on fire with more powerful heat.

skills.name: Flame Body - Trial
skills.description: Increases physical damage by burning your own body.
skills.study: The fire energy makes it seem like the body is burning, but it is fire of energy and not actual fire, so the body is not actually burnt. The Flame Body Series consists of five skills. The fourth stage which is Trial is the stage of enhancing the flame and controlling the body with flame.

skills.name: Basic Fire protection
skills.description: Exercises the Fire Force to increase the resistence against magic.
skills.study: The first skill of Fire Protection Series is to extend the range of the wall of fire by a certain distance from the abdomen.

skills.name: Divine Fire protection
skills.description: Exercises the Fire Force to increase the resistence against magic.
skills.study: The second skill of Fire Protection Series is called Divine Fire Protection. It is the stage of strengthening the durability of the defense after extending it to the specified point.

skills.name: Hard Fire protection
skills.description: Exercises the Fire Force to increase the resistence against magic.
skills.study: The third skill of Fire Protection Series uses a spinning wall of fire to cover up vulenerable weaknesses.

skills.name: Earth Fire Protection
skills.description: Exercises the Fire Force to increase the resistence against magic.
skills.study: The fourth skill of Fire Protection Series is the stage of intensifying the field of flame by using the hot energy of absorbed lava from underground.

skills.name: Fire Wall - Tower
skills.description: Absorbs the magical attack by creating a wall of fire.
skills.study: The first skill of Fire Wall Series is called Tower because it looks like a tower soaring high in the open field.

skills.name: Fire Wall - Mountain
skills.description: Absorbs the magical attack by creating a wall of fire.
skills.study: The second skill of Fire Wall Series is called Huge Mountain because it looks like a great mountain.

skills.name: Fire Wall - Castle
skills.description: Absorbs the magical attack by creating a wall of fire.
skills.study: The third skill of Fire Wall Series is called Castle because it looks like a stronghold which would never collapse.

skills.name: Flame Wave - Arrow
skills.description: Launches the far ranged attack of fire trait.
skills.study: It flies at the enemy and gives damage to them like an arrow of fire. The first skill of Flame Wave Series.

skills.name: Flame Wave - Burning
skills.description: Launches the ranged attackof fire trait in front .
skills.study: The flame is like the fire of Hell burns and will sweep away all obstructing enemies. The second skill of the Flame Wave Series.

skills.name: Flame Wave - Wide
skills.description: Launches the far ranged attack of fire trait.
skills.study: The flame shines in an instance and explodes to sweep the enemies in a wide range. The third move of the Flame Wave Series.

skills.name: Flame Wave - Bomb
skills.description: Launches the strong far ranged attack of fire trait.
skills.study: The huge flame of fire explodes like a bomb and instantly pulverises the surrounding enemies. It is the fourth move of the Flame Wave Series.

skills.name: Fire Combustion - Firefly
skills.description: Detects enemies in stealth state. (stealth is not implemented yet — no effect)
skills.study: Inner energy is used to create small firefly-like fires in the eyes which are then used for detecting hiding enemies,

skills.name: Vision Fire Combustion
skills.description: Detects enemies in invisible state. (invisibility is not implemented yet — no effect)
skills.study: Detect unseen enemies by removing the energy that disturbs the vision, as if a clear sky is shown by removing the clouds.

skills.name: Fire Combustion - Light
skills.description: Detects enemies in stealth state. (stealth is not implemented yet — no effect)
skills.study: Insert dark illuminating fire energy made with intensified inner energy into the eyes to detect hiding enemies.

skills.name: Flame Devil Force
skills.description: Permanently increases the physical damage by the specified amount.
skills.study: The Hwaryeong sect lays stress mainly on training the attack skills agreeable to their warlike and aggressive traits. Otherwise known as the Fire Force Mastery, its disciples gain their vigor and inner force by recieving the force of Fire and infusing it into the blood vessel and circulating it through. Its power depends on the intensity and level of training.

skills.name: Self Breathe Heal
skills.description: Recovers one's own HP.
skills.study: Cures one's inner injury and allows one to regain catch their breath if they follow a certain procedure.

skills.name: Self Force Heal
skills.description: Recovers one's own HP a little bit more.
skills.study: Cures one's inner injury allowing them to catch their breath if they follow a certain procedure of circulating inner force.

skills.name: Self Wounds Heal
skills.description: Recovers one's own HP a lot.
skills.study: Cures one's inner injury by absorbing vital force accumulated in the body.

skills.name: Self Vital Heal
skills.description: Recovers one's own HP by a large amount.
skills.study: Cures both physical wounds and inner injuries by circulating the absorbed vital force.

skills.name: Force Cure - Poison
skills.description: Randomly cures 2 bad statuses.
skills.study: As the first training of Force Cure Series, it cures the most basic abnormal states.

skills.name: Force Cure - Body
skills.description: Randomly cures 2 bad statuses.
skills.study: As the second training of Force Cure Series, it cures the worst abnormal states by raising one's immunity.

skills.name: Force Cure - Condiion
skills.description: Randomly cures 2 bad statuses.
skills.study: As the third training of Force Cure Series, it cures the most critical abnormal states by operating the inner force of the body smoothly.

skills.name: Force Cure - Vital
skills.description: Randomly cures 2 bad statuses.
skills.study: Cures both external wounds and inner injuries by circulating the absorbed vital force and by using the potential of healing.

skills.name: Cure Therapy - Pure
skills.description: Randomly cures 2 bad statuses of party members in a fixed area.
skills.study: The first stage of Cure Therapy, Pure, is a stage where the correct cure is given to comrades after judging their status.

skills.name: Cure Therapy - Protection
skills.description: Randomly cures 2 bad statuses of party members in a fixed area.
skills.study: The second stage of Cure Therapy, Protection, is a stage where prevention of bad status as well being able to cure such statuses is made possible by relaxing the comrades' body and mind.

skills.name: Heal - Medical Hand
skills.description: Recovers the selected target's HP.
skills.study: The first of six stages in the medical manual of the Heal Series is Medical Hand which cures the patient with human power.

skills.name: Heal - Ghost Hand
skills.description: Recovers the selected target's HP a little bit more.
skills.study: The second of six stages in the medical manual of the Heal Series is Ghost Hand which cures the patient with ghostly power.

skills.name: Heal - Taoist Hand
skills.description: Recovers the selected target's HP a lot.
skills.study: The third of six stages in the medical manual of the Heal Series is Taoist Hand which cures the patient with supernatural power.

skills.name: Heal - Mysterious Hand
skills.description: Recovers the selected target's HP a lot.
skills.study: The fourth of six stages in the medical manual of the Heal Series is Mysterious Hand which cures targets with power of a mysterious animal.

skills.name: Soul Rebirth Art
skills.description: Resurrects the dead character.
skills.study: The Soul Rebirth Art is able to revive a man who just died.

skills.name: Ghost Rebirth Art
skills.description: Resurrects the dead character.
skills.study: The Ghost Rebirth Art is said to be able to revive even men who have lost their souls to the nether world.

skills.name: Spirit Rebirth Art
skills.description: Resurrects the dead character.
skills.study: The Spirit Rebirth Art is able to revive souls who died and are already in the purgatory.

skills.name: Return Rebirth Art
skills.description: Resurrects the dead character.
skills.study: Return Rebirth Art is said to be able to even bring back souls bound to Hades.

skills.name: Harmony Therapy
skills.description: Increases the speed of recovery and exercises the blocking magic against a preemptive strike from the monsters.
skills.study: By understanding the principles of nature and being in harmony with it, you recieve vital force from it and are able to hide your inner force.

skills.name: Adaptation Therapy
skills.description: Increases the speed of recovery and exercises blocking magic against a preemptive strike from the monsters.
skills.study: This stage consists of not just being at harmony with nature but being one with it, allowing for greater life strength. Hides one's force from stronger enemies.

skills.name: Whole Therapy
skills.description: Increases the speed of recovery and exercises blocking magic against a preemptive strike from the monsters.
skills.study: This stage consists of being united not only to nature but also to things nearby. This increases one's living power further and hides their inner force.

skills.name: Vital Spot - Muscle
skills.description: Decreases the enemy's dodge ability.
skills.study: By infusing the force into the opponent's muscle-related special blood points, you dullen their muscles and decrease their dodge ability.

skills.name: Vital Spot - Spirit
skills.description: Decreases the enemy's hitting ratios
skills.study: By infusing the force into the opponent's spirit-related special blood points, you dullen his ability to concentrate and decrease his attack success ratio.

skills.name: Vital Spot - Body
skills.description: Decreases the enemy's physical defense power.
skills.study: By infusing the force into the target's physical related blood points, it weakens the target's health resulting in the decrease of his physical defense power.

skills.name: Vital Spot - Mind
skills.description: Decreases the enemy's magical defense power.
skills.study: By infusing the force into the target's mind related blood points, it disturbs the target's judgment resulting in the decrease of his magical defense power.

skills.name: Vital Spot - Zero
skills.description: Decreases the enemy's physical and magical attack power.
skills.study: By infusing the force into the target's motion related blood points, it incapacitates the target's body resulting in the decrease of his magical attack damage.

skills.name: Force Increasing
skills.description: Permanently increases the maximum MP point by the specified amount.
skills.study: The Gihyeol Sect disciples who consume inner force relatively more are able to increase the quantity of their inner force by training The Force Power Mastery steadily. The disciples visit the steep mountains and deep valleys to train The Force Power Mastery.

skills.name: Taunting Target
skills.description: Roars at the enemy to attract his attention to yourself.

skills.name: Vital Increase
skills.description: Increases your HP in exchange for reducing your physical and magical damage by a certain degree because you are so committed to survival.

skills.name: Descry
skills.description: Enables everyone nearby you to detect all subjects around in the stealth state for a certain time by imbuing them with a sign made of physical energy. The sign does not work if descry level is lower than stealth level. The descry skills are not applied to yourself or party members.

skills.name: Sprint Assault
skills.description: Enables you to storm into the enemy and attack it at lightning speed with a nimble body made by muscle training that enhances reflective nerves. The enemy who not ready for sudden attacks either faints or knocked back, .
skills.study: Enables you to storm into the enemy and attack it at lightning speed with a nimble body made by muscle training that enhances reflective nerves. The enemy who not ready for sudden attacks either faints or knocked back,

skills.name: Iron Skin
skills.description: Turns your skin as hard as steel and enhances your physical defensive skills by translating the unyielding warrior spirit into the commitment to fighting against the enemy's physical attacks.

skills.name: Howling Shout
skills.description: Shouts a loud roar to provoke enemies around you and draw their attention on you.
skills.study: Shouts a loud roar to provoke enemies around you and draw their attention to you.

skills.name: Mana Skin
skills.description: Translate internal spirit into the commitment to fighting against the enemy's magical attacks, protecting your skin with mana and enhancing your magical defensive power.

skills.name: Pain Quota
skills.description: Enhances the unity of sharing pain with party members. It creates a protecting layer of unity for one of the party members, excluding yourself, for a certain period of time, so that the damage inflicted upon one member can be evenly distributed to all party members.

skills.name: Physical Fence
skills.description: Creates a protecting layer consisting of warriors' conviction for only one member. By using the skill, you divert part of physical damage from one member to yourself for a certain period of time. You cannot use the skill for yourself and the protecting layer disappears when you go beyond a certain range.

skills.name: Magical Fence
skills.description: Creates for only one member a protecting layer consisting of warriors' guarding conviction. By using the skill, you divert part of magical damage from one member to yourself for a certain period of time. You cannot use the skill for yourself and the protecting layer disappears when you go beyond a certain range.

skills.name: Protect
skills.description: Provokes the enemies to divert some of their hostility from one member to yourself for a certain time.

skills.name: Physical Screen
skills.description: Creates a defensive layer made of your strong commitment to one member and increases that member's physical defensive power for a certain period of time. You cannot use the skill on yourself.

skills.name: Morale Screen
skills.description: For the target of protection, this skill creates a defensive shield made from the warrior's strong spritual strength, and increases the target's magical defense. Cannot be used on yourself.

skills.name: One-Handed Arms
skills.description: Increases your physical offensive power to a certain percentage by practicing and concentrating all your internal strength on improving your one-handed sword. The skill works when the attack is made with a one-handed sword.

skills.name: Power Shield
skills.description: Enhances your physical defensive power by equipping your one-handed sword and shield with your strong defense commitment.

skills.name: Blockade
skills.description: Enhances your blocking rate by learning how to effectively handle an one-handed sword and the shield in your respective hands.
skills.study: Enhances your blocking rate by learning how to effectively deal with the one-handed sword and the shield in your respective hands.

skills.name: Critical Void
skills.description: Lowers the probability of getting a deathblow from the enemy by obtaining the skill to protect yourself against your weaknesses.
skills.study: Lowers the likelihood of suffering a deathblow from the enemy by obtaining the skill to protect yourself against your weaknesses.

skills.name: Slash
skills.description: Gives a serious blow to an enemy vertically wounding him with a one-handed sword using the strength mustered from within your body. You can use the skill on a subject who is lying on the ground.

skills.name: Shield Trash
skills.description: Wields your shield strongly to inflict damage upon enemies on the front. Perplexed by the sudden attack, the enemies step back or slow down temporarily.

skills.name: Double Stab
skills.description: Stabbing the upper or middle part of a subject gives greater damages especially when the target subject is restrained, asleep, faint or has slowed down. The enemy gets a serious blow when his weak spot is attacked.
skills.study: This is all about stabbing the upper or middle part of a subject when the target subject is restrained, asleep, faint or has slowed down. The enemy faces a serious blow with his weak spot attacked.

skills.name: Berserker
skills.description: Gives enormous pain to the enemy by wounding him for two consecutive times after wielding your one-handed sword containing the energy from your HP that improves your offensive power. You cannot use the skill when your HP is below 10%.

skills.name: Shield Crush
skills.description: Deals a serious blow to enemies around you by wielding your shield containing your strong determination to battle. Enemies outpowered by the strength from the flourished shield either step back or slow down temporarily.
skills.study: Deals a serious blow to enemies around you by wielding your shield with your strong determination to battle. Enemies outpowered by the strength from the flourished shield either step back or slow down temporarily.

skills.name: Cunning Stab
skills.description: A skill that stabs the enemy under abnormal status with the one-handed sword 4 times. Gives extra damage when the target enemy is under bind, sleep, stun, or dull status.
skills.study: A skill that thrusts the enemy under abnormal status with the one-handed sword 4 times. Deals extra damage when the target enemy is under bind, sleep, stun, or dull status.

skills.name: Daring Berserker
skills.description: Wields one-handed sword for 4 consecutive times with air energy consuming your HP. This makes extreme offensive power to give fatal wounds to enemies. You cannot use the skill when your HP is below 10%.

skills.name: Two-Handed Arms
skills.description: Enhances your physical offensive power by a certain percentage by practicing skills to concentrate the force of energy in your body to your two hands flourshing your two-handed sword. The skill works when the two-handed sword skills are used.

skills.name: Concentration
skills.description: Enhances your concentration on battles to increase your chance of giving a serious blow to the enemy.
skills.study: Enhances your concentration on battles to increase your chance of dealing a serious blow to the enemy.

skills.name: Damage Return
skills.description: Returns a certain porportion of the physical damage aimed at yourself by obtaining the skill to aggressively fight against the enemy's physical attacks.

skills.name: Bash
skills.description: Attacks a subject by flourishing the two-handed sword as hard as you can. You can use the skill on a subject who is lying on the ground as well. Enemies that suffer a strong blow are pushed back.

skills.name: Turn Rising
skills.description: Allows you to deal a blow to the enemy by turning halfway around and slaying the enemy with the two-handed sword diagonally from bottom to top. Those failing to counter the attack are likely to be knocked down.

skills.name: Warcry
skills.description: A cry that improves your commitment to battle so that your physical damage can be enhanced temporarily.

skills.name: Charge Swing
skills.description: "Deals a huge blow to the enemy by strongly rushing toward the subject and lowering the two-handed sword to hit the enemy with it from below; this can be used on a subject lying down on the ground as well. When a subject is under bind, sleep, faint, dull, or knocked-down, it gives greater damages. "

skills.name: Maddening
skills.description: "Consumes your HP to awake your anger inside you and flourish the two-handed sword at the enemy as if drawing a huge circle. The attack with strong power penetrates through the enemy to deal a blow to other enemies close by; those failing to counter the attack become either faint or knocked back. This skill cannot be used when HP is below 10%. "

skills.name: Triple Swing
skills.description: Strongly wields the two-hand sword at the enemy, dealing 3 deadly blows. Can be used on enemies lying on the ground as well, and will deal greater damage to enemies when they are under bind, sleep, faint, or dull status.

skills.name: Dare Devil
skills.description: Awakes vicious madness like the devil by consuming one's HP, and wields the two-hand sword twice as if drawing a circle at the enemy. This attack with great power will penetrate the enemy and attack nearby enemies as well, and those who cannot block this attack will be knock backed. This skill cannot be used when HP is below 10%.
skills.study: Awakes vicious madness like the devil by consuming ones HP, and wields the two-hand sword twice in a circle at the enemy. This attack with great power will penetrate the enemy and attack nearby enemies as well, and those who cannot block this attack will be knock backed. This skill cannot be used when HP is below 10%.

skills.name: Dual Arms
skills.description: Increases your physical offensive power to a certain extent by acquiring the skill to put strong power on the dual axe. It works when dual axe skills are applied.

skills.name: Accuracy
skills.description: Enhances your hit rate by learning how to use the dual axe to aim precisely at the enemy's weaknesses. It works when dual axe skills are applied.
skills.study: Enhances your hit rate by learning how to use the dual axe--identifying the enemy's weaknesses and accurately aiming them. It works when dual axe skills are applied.

skills.name: Protection
skills.description: Improves your defensive power against bad-status attacks of the Weakening Line by learning the skills to prepare against external shocks utilizing the dual axe.

skills.name: Dual Defense
skills.description: Enhances your physical defensive power by learning how to use dual axe to effectively deal with the enemy's physical attacks.
skills.study: Uses the dual axe to enhance your physical defensive power by learning the skill to effectively deal with the enemy's physical attacks.

skills.name: Down Cross
skills.description: Deals a blow to the enemy by hitting the subject with the dual axe from top to bottom. You can use the skill for the subject lying on the ground as well.
skills.study: Deals a blow to the enemy by hitting the subject with the dual axe from top to bottom as if drawing a cross. You can use the skill for the subject lying on the ground as well.

skills.name: Double Twist
skills.description: Deals a blow to the enemy by diagonally flourishing the dual axe twice rapidly. Those failing to overcome the shock are likely to bleed or faint.

skills.name: Axis Quiver
skills.description: Makes enemies within a certain range faint by strongly hitting the ground with the axe to send a strong shockwave that reverberates through the axis of the earth.

skills.name: Dual Counter
skills.description: It deals a huge blow to the enemy by rapidly flourishing the dual axe several times. The strongly flourished dual axe damages enemies on the front line, too. Deals greater damage to enemies when they are under bind, sleep, stun, or dull status.

skills.name: Crisis Rush
skills.description: Consumes your HP to awake the potential energy within your body. You concentrate your energy on the dual axe to attack the enemy for 4 consecutive times. You cannot use the skill when your HP is below 10%.

skills.name: Sudden Twist
skills.description: Strongly attacks an enemy by flourishing your dual axe with your hands moving so fast that they become virtually invisible. Those failing to overcome the shock either bleed or become stunned.
skills.study: Strongly attacks the enemy by flourishing your dual axe with your hands moving so fast that they become virtually invisible. Those failing to overcome the shock either bleed or become stunned.

skills.name: Deadly Counter
skills.description: Deals critical damage on targets with the dual axe when the target is caught off guard. This skill also deals damage on enemies at the front line. Dealing greater damage when the target is under bind, sleep, stun, or dull status.

skills.name: Crutial Rush
skills.description: Consumes your HP to awake the subconscious energy inside you and charge at the enemy wielding the dual axe with great power, dealing 5 consecutive hits. This skill cannot be used when HP is below 10%.

skills.name: Earth Spirit
skills.description: Amplifies unstable inner energy on the ground and increases magical offensive power when using the Earth line skills.

skills.name: Cold Spirit
skills.description: Amplifies cold and static inner energy of water and increases magical offensive power when using the Cold line skills.

skills.name: Fire Spirit
skills.description: Amplifies explosive inner energy of fire and increases magical offensive power when using the Fire line skills.

skills.name: Lightning Spirit
skills.description: Amplifies electric energy scattered in the air and increases magical offensive power when using the Lightning line skills.

skills.name: Intelligence
skills.description: Enables you to consume less MP when using Wizard skills by studying how to effectively deal with mana.

skills.name: Life Control
skills.description: Using some of your vitality, make amplified energy by fastly circulating mana within the body. Maximum HP decreases for a certain period of time, but magical damage increases according to your lose.

skills.name: Magic Bound
skills.description: Improves your capability to amplify energy by better understanding the essence of mana. Using amplified energy allows you to have a longer range of influence so that you can increase the magic range when using Wizard skills.

skills.name: Life Turnover
skills.description: Increase instant mana usage by using the energy made by transferring your life power onto natural element. For a fixed time, your maximum HP is reduced, but massive amount of mana will rise inside your body resulting in a magical damage increase.

skills.name: Ground Charge
skills.description: Musters up and releases earth energy on the Earth to damage surrounding enemies.
skills.study: Musters up and releases earth energy dividing the Earth to damage surrounding enemies.

skills.name: Root
skills.description: Infuses the Earth force into an enemy's feet and restrains him on the ground. Those failing to endure the force injected to their bodies cannot move temporarily.

skills.name: Earth Shock
skills.description: Gathers unstable forces of the Earth and blasts them off to your enemies, shaking the ground the enemies stand on. Those failing to endure the impact are slowed down.

skills.name: Earth Barrier
skills.description: Creates a temporary protecting layer that absorbs physical damage for you by using the static energy of the Earth.

skills.name: Ground Rave
skills.description: Extracts an explosive power of vibrant Earth through mana and releases it to seriously damage enemies nearby.

skills.name: Mesh Root
skills.description: Energy with the force of Earth is thrown at a target, causing a net of Earth force to spread from the target. Targets become vulnerable to the Earth force, and those that cannot tolerate the force will be unable to move temporarily.

skills.name: Earth Quake
skills.description: A vicious force hidden in the inner Earth is gathered and merged with mana to create energy that is thrown at the enemies on the front line. A sudden quake of Earth occurs when the huge energy hits the ground, causing great damage to enemies. Enemies that cannot tolerate this damage will become dull.

skills.name: Earth Fence
skills.description: A solid defensive shield that absorbs physical damage is made from the energy wave of the Earth, to protect yourself for a fixed time.

skills.name: Ice Bolt
skills.description: This is for shooting ice bolts at a target. The spot hit can get extremely cold with pain and those failing to overcome the chill get frozen or frostbitten.

skills.name: Mana Drain
skills.description: Decreases mana around your target by freezing it with a cold force. Lowered mana undermines your target's ability to focus his mind in MP recovery and making him panic. Once this is applied, enemies needs 4 more seconds to apply MP potion. This skill is not effective on monsters.

skills.name: Snow Wind
skills.description: Blasts cold energy at a target and causes snow winds in a wide area around him. Those around the target suffer coldness. Those failing to endure the coldness get frozen or frostbitten.

skills.name: Invisible
skills.description: Combines extreme coldness and mana, making yourself invisible temporarily. You are invisible to all except your party members. Upon moving or using other skills, your invisible status ends. When invisible, your moves slow down and you are invisible to those whose detection level is lower than your invisible level.

skills.name: Frozen Spear
skills.description: Makes a sphere with extreme energy in it and throws it three times in a row. Those failing to endure the successive cold impact get frozen or frostbitten.

skills.name: Mana Drought
skills.description: Freezes mana around a target by exploding cold energy in a wide area. Enemies that cannot control their mana will have lowered mana capacity, and their mind weakens giving them the panic state. This troubles their MP recovery. Under panic state there will be a 4 second delay when HP, MP potion is consumed. This skill is not effective on monsters.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.description: This skill creates a powerful blizzard in an area, made from the merge of water energy in the air and ice energy. Enemies vulnerable to cold will feel the pain of their flesh being cut, and those that do not tolerate the cold will be frozen or frostbitten.

skills.name: Crystal Invisible
skills.description: Infuses mana with cold energy into yourself and party members, making them invisible like crystals for a fixed time. You and the party members will not be seen by any other targets, but the invisible state will be removed when other skills are used.
skills.study: Infuses mana merged with cold energy into yourself and party members, making them invisible like a crystal for a fixed time. You and the party members will not be seen by any other targets, but the invisible state will be removed when other skills are used.

skills.name: Fire Bolt
skills.description: This is for shooting fire bolts at an enemy. The attack leaves a heart-burning pain to a target and those failing to endure the pain get burned.

skills.name: Fire Trap
skills.description: Plants fire traps that are invisible damage those stepping on them. Those failing to endure the force of fire get burned. When the planter goes beyond a certain distance from the traps, they cease to exist. Those in destealth status can detect traps.

skills.name: Fire Blow
skills.description: Gathers fire forces scattered in the air, turns them into flames and spouts them in a single line. Any target in contact with the flames gets damaged. Those failing to overcome the heat get burned.

skills.name: Detect
skills.description: Enables you to discover an invisible enemy by spreading flames of detection around yourself. Once discovered, the subject remains visible to all for a while.

skills.name: Meteor
skills.description: Summons a meteor of flames falling like a heavy rain around your enemy in a wide range. Those exposed to the flames suffer pain. Those failing to overcome the pain get burned.

skills.name: Lava Trap
skills.description: Traps made from the burning energy of lava are hidden, and targets that step the trap will feel a burning pain and get great damage. The trap will deal burn damage to those who cannot tolerate the pain. The trap will disappear when the planter goes beyond a certain distance. Those in destealth status can detect traps.

skills.name: Salamander Blow
skills.description: Emits in a row, salamander breath made by burning the mana inside the body with flame energy. Enemies exposed to the breath will be damaged greatly. Those who cannot tolerate the heat will get burned.
skills.study: Emits in a row, salamander breath made by burning the mana inside the body with flame energy. Enemies exposed to the breath will be damaged greatly. Those who cannot tolerate the heat will become burned.

skills.name: Sprawl Detect
skills.description: A skill that detects targets in invisible state by spreading bright sparks that lighten vision around yourself. Detected enemies will be exposed to all targets for a fixed time. Cannot detect targets with higher invisible level than your detect level.

skills.name: Lightning Bolt
skills.description: Shoots an arrow made from electric energy. Those failing to bear the impact get electrocuted.

skills.name: Lightning Shock
