skills.description: Instantly releases massive amount of electric energy from your body. Panicked at sudden electric attacks and fearing electrocution, enemies do not dare fight back.
skills.study: Instantly releases massive amount of electric energy from within your body. Panicked at sudden electric attacks and fearing electrocution, enemies do not dare fight back.

skills.name: Charged Wind
skills.description: Creates electric winds using rapid flows of electricity and uses them to attack enemies in a certain range. Exposed to the electric blast, they cannot confront the impact and get pushed back.

skills.name: Teleport
skills.description: Combines mana with electric energy scattered in the air to create instant energy. You can teleport yourself to far areas using this energy.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.description: You attack an enemy with electric energy and spread it to more enemies surrounding the first subject. Those failing to bear the electric impact get electrocuted.

skills.name: Lightning Impact
skills.description: Burst forth powerful electrical energy made by merging small energy in the air with electrical energy in your body. Those who cannot tolerate the powerful electrical damage will be wrapped in fear and will not be able to attack.

skills.name: Charged Squall
skills.description: Pour consecutive electrical attacks to enemies surrounded by vicious electrical typhoon, that is made by colliding electrical particles with mana. Those who cannot tolerate the damage will be knocked back.

skills.name: Aerial Teleport
skills.description: Teleports your body a distance by assimilating your body with the air through the use of energy that is made by quickly vibrating the small electrical particles that exist around.

skills.name: Stealth Extension
skills.description: Increases stealth lasting time by assimilating yourself in the darkness longer.
skills.study: Increases stealth lasting time by assimilating yourself into darkness longer.

skills.name: Scorn
skills.description: Mocks an enemy and draws his attention to you so that he cannot chase his targets temporarily. You cannot use the skill against monsters.
skills.study: Scorns an enemy and draws his attention to you so that he cannot chase his targets temporarily. You cannot use the skill against monsters.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Makes yourself temporarily invisible to your enemy by being absorbed into the darkness, which is the stealth state. In stealth state, you move slower than usual and are invisible to those whose destealth, descry and levels that are lower than your stealth level.

skills.name: Destealth
skills.description: Enables you, using your inner concentration, to temporarily spot an enemy who is in stealth state by picking up his traces in the dark. You can also find fire and lava traps planted by an enemy. You cannot spot those whose stealth levels are higher than your destealth level.

skills.name: Tag Point
skills.description: Puts a trace on your target so that you can temporarily locate him. His location appears on a mini-map and the world map. If the target goes beyond a certain distance, his trace disappears. This skill cannot be used on monsters.

skills.name: Gross Scorn
skills.description: Harshly jeers at an enemy to draw his attention to you and temporarily stops him from chasing his targets. You cannot use the skill against Monsters.

skills.name: Intensive Stealth
skills.description: Unite with the dark of the deep abyss and use a stealth status that enemies cannot see you. Under stealth status the movement speed decreases, but cannot be detected from destealth and descry land evels lower than your stealth level.

skills.name: Intensive Destealth
skills.description: Using high concentration, with eyes that see through the dark of deep abyss, you can detect enemies under stealth state by finding traces in the dark. You can also detect Fire Traps and Lava Traps placed by the enemies. You cannot detect targets with higher stealth level than your destealth level.

skills.name: Poison Weapons
skills.description: This is about applying poison on a dagger or a bolt and thrusting them into the body of your enemy, so that he will be poisoned. Once you smear poison on your weapon, the effect lasts for a certain period.

skills.name: Poison Circle
skills.description: Spouts curse-weakening powder extracted from strong poison to lower the likelihood of you and your party members getting the Curse Line of bad status and to decrease the effect of the status.

skills.name: Poison Field
skills.description: Burst a bag of poison around yourself and diffuses poisonous fumes to poison nearby enemies.

skills.name: Poison Trap
skills.description: This is about planting poison-spewing seeds into the ground so that an enemy stepping on it gets damaged.

skills.name: Vein Weapon
skills.description: Deals greater damage to an enemy with a dagger or bolt that has upgraded fetal poison on it. Those that cannot tolerate the poison will get the poison status. Once the poison is put on the weapon, the affect will last for a fixed amount of time.

skills.name: Vein Circle
skills.description: From the crystal of deadly poison that can kill others with a small amount, energy that weakens curse is extracted, then made into powder. This powder is used to lower the chance and damage of party members, including yourself, from getting the curse related status error.

skills.name: Monster Mask
skills.description: Enables you to absorb energy from a dead monster and create Death Essence to transform yourself into a monster. The disguise lasts up untill you are in the loading area or dead, and you can use the monster's basic attack but your HP and attack power will remain the same.
skills.study: Enables you to absorb energy from a dead monster and create Death Essence to transform yourself into a monster. The disguise lasts for a certain amount of time and you can use the monster's basic attack but your HP and attack power will remain the same.

skills.name: Duplicate
skills.description: Makes yourself look just like anyone you choose by using shadows of darkness. But you cannot transform yourself into a monster with this skill. You return to your original appearance when you use a skill, enter loading areas or get killed while transformed.

skills.name: Beast Mask
skills.description: Learn the method of using the energy of the dead from the dark, allowing yourself to create higher level of Death Essence from dead monsters. Using the Death Essence will transform you into the monster for a fixed time, and you can use the monster's skills but your HP and attack power will remain the same. And you go back to your original state when you are in loading area or dead.

skills.name: Crossbow Power Up
skills.description: Enhances crossbow offensive power by obtaining the skill that increases the power of a bolt loaded into your crossbow. The skill works effectively with crossbow skills.

skills.name: Wide Sight
skills.description: Enhances your eyesight by training yourself to see objects in darkness. With broader sight, you can shoot a bolt to enemies from a further distance. This is effective when you use crossbow skills.

skills.name: Avoid
skills.description: Enhances your ability to decrease long-distance physical damage by studying crossbow attacks and get a better understanding of long-distance attacks.

skills.name: Crossbow Extreme
skills.description: Increases your Critical hit and gives more physical damage by creating extreme energy from your HP and physical defensive power and transferring the energy into a crossbow. You can use this skill only when you're armed with a crossbow.

skills.name: Power Shot
skills.description: This is about shooting a bolt at an enemy with full force using the strength put together from within your body. Those failing to endure the impact get pushed back.

skills.name: Fast Shot
skills.description: Quickly feeds bolts to your enemies.
skills.study: Quickly feeds bolts to attack your enemies.

skills.name: Long Shot
skills.description: Enables you, using eyes trained in the dark, to shoot a bolt at the heart of an enemy from long distances.

skills.name: Blast Shot
skills.description: Inflicts impact and physical damage on your target by shooting a bolt that causes a strong blast. Those failing to endure the impact get knocked down.
skills.study: Inflicts impact and physical damage on your target by shooting a bolt that causes a strong blast. Those failing to endure the impact get knocked down.

skills.name: Intense Shot
skills.description: Pulls your strong combat commitment and internal energy into bolts to shoot them two rounds consecutively. Those failing to endure the impact get pushed back.

skills.name: Rapid Shot
skills.description: Enhances crossbow skills and enables you to attack multiple enemies by rapidly shooting bolts at them.

skills.name: Distance Shot
skills.description: Through mind concentration, this skill maximizes the rogue's sight, allowing them to attack the heart of the target at a far distance with bolts.

skills.name: Hurricane Shot
skills.description: Deals physical damage with great impact by shooting bolts twice in a row that cause a powerful windstorm. Enemies that cannot tolerate the impact will be knocked down.

skills.name: Dagger Power Up
skills.description: Increases dagger-based offensive power by obtaining the skill to muster up strength and thrust a dagger into an enemy. It works when you use dagger skills.

skills.name: Hawk Eye
skills.description: Enables you to closely follow your subject's moves like a hawk and increase your hit rate. It works when you use dagger skills.

skills.name: Poison Power Up
skills.description: Increases poison damage and poison levels by studying and better understanding various kinds of poison. This skill works when you are armed with a dagger and use poison skills.
skills.study: Increases poison damage and poison levels by studying and better understanding various kinds of poison. This skill works when you are armed with a dagger and use poison skills.

skills.name: Venom Extension
skills.description: Makes poison effect last longer by picking up recipes for stronger poisons. This skill works when you are armed with a dagger and use poison skills.
skills.study: Makes poison effect last longer by picking up recipes for stronger poisons. This skill works when you are armed with a dagger and use poison skills.

skills.name: Stealth Dagger
skills.description: Through training of assimilating in the dark, the rogue increases the attack power of daggers by learning a skill that allows the rogue to wield the dagger in the dark. This skill is only effective under stealth status.

skills.name: Quick Step
skills.description: Enables you to move faster by acquiring the skill to hide your presence and swiftly move your feet in stealth status. This skill works when you are armed with a dagger and use stealth.

skills.name: Dagger Desperate
skills.description: Temporarily increases the Critical hit rate and physical damage by consuming your physical and magical defensive powers. You can use this skill only when you are armed with a dagger.

skills.name: Spinning
skills.description: This is a successive attack skill. You give a deep slash in the lower part of the body with a dagger and a twist kick into the upper body part.

skills.name: Wounds
skills.description: This is about approaching an enemy and fiercely scratching him with a dagger using turning force. Those failing to endure the impact bleed. You can also use the skill on a subject who is lying or has fallen down on the ground.

skills.name: Scud
skills.description: Relaxes the muscles and lightens the body movement by holding the breath, resulting in increased movement speed for fixed time.

skills.name: Screw
skills.description: This is about approaching an enemy with a dagger, twisting your hand and thrusting it into him. An enemy failing to endure the impact gets knocked down.

skills.name: Combo Blow
skills.description: Attacks the lovwer body part of an enemy for few times. The impact is so huge that he slows down.
skills.study: Shortly musters up your strength before attacking the lower body part of an enemy in succession. The impact is so huge that he slows down.

skills.name: Prick
skills.description: Musters up energy from your HP and internal strength and transfers it into a dagger to stab weak spots of an enemy with force. Those failing to endure the impact bleed. You cannot use the skill when your HP is below 10%.

skills.name: Mortal Wounds
skills.description: Deals a fatal blow to an enemy by focusing your attacks on his weak spots for few times. Those failing to endure the impact of rapid attacks bleed. You can also use the skill on an enemy who is lying or has fallen on the ground.

skills.name: Butterfly Blow
skills.description: By using the subconscious energy inside the body, the rogue deals damage on an enemy through speedy consecutive attacks with stylish movement like a butterfly. Enemies that cannot tolerate the damage will be under dull status.

skills.name: Dark Seed
skills.description: Sows Dark Seeds created with anger in the enemies mind. It makes the attack more effective when using skills from Dark Mentalist Line.
skills.study: Sows Dark Seeds created with anger from the enemies mind. It makes the attack more effective when using skills from Dark Mentalist Line.

skills.name: Strap
skills.description: Enhances the capability to control enemies with a weaker mind. It makes the attack time longer when using skills from the Dark Mentalist Line.

skills.name: Blaze
skills.description: Puts enemies in a blaze of curses and causes magical damage to them for a while. Enemies who fail to overcome the blaze get burned for a while and get additional burn damage.

skills.name: Toxin
skills.description: Condenses toxins floating in the air into curse energy and blows it into enemies, causing magical damage for a while. Enemies who fail to overcome the power of the curses soaked in the toxin become poisoned for a while and get additional toxin damage.
skills.study: Condenses toxins floating in the air into curse energy and blows it onto enemies, causing magical damage for a while. Enemies who fail to overcome the power of the curses soaked in the toxin become poisoned for a while and get additional toxin damage.

skills.name: Decayed
skills.description: Blows the power of death absorbed from decayed bodies on enemies to cause magical damage to them for a while periodically. Enemies who fail to overcome the power of death have decayed skin and keep bleeding.

skills.name: Curse Breath
skills.description: Blows the breath of curses on enemies to put them in pain for a while. Enemies who fail to overcome the curse lose strength and become dull.

skills.name: Dark Blaze
skills.description: Puts enemies in a blaze created by curse and flame energy for a while to cause magical damage to them. Enemies who fail to overcome the heat of the blaze get burned and get additional burn damage.

skills.name: Toxin Invasion
skills.description: Enhances the effectiveness of the toxin energy created from the harmful energy in the air by using curse energy and blowing it on enemies to cause magical damage to them for a while. Enemies who fail to overcome the power of toxin and curse energy become poisoned and get additional toxin damage.

skills.name: Dark Decayed
skills.description: Breathe in the energy of agony and dark absorbed from the gruesomely distorted dead bodies into the bodies of enemies, causing constant magical damage for a fixed time. Those who surrender to the energy of agony and dark will feel their body decay, and constant bleeding will take place, causing a bleed state.

skills.name: Dark Breath
skills.description: Breathes the breath of dark into the target, causing pain to the target for a fixed time. Those who cannot tolerate the energy of the dark will lose their energy and fall into dull state.

skills.name: Physical Raze
skills.description: Reduces physical defensive power of enemies for a while by blowing the curse that causes powerlessness into them and making them tired.

skills.name: Medical Raze
skills.description: Reduces magical defensive power of enemies for a while by overwhelming them with the curse created from hatred.

skills.name: Combat Raze
skills.description: Reduces the physical and magical offensive power of enemies for a while by inserting the dark power into enemy's tired body and lowering enemy's will to fight.
skills.study: Reduces the physical and magical offensive power of enemies for a while by inserting the dark power into their tired body and lowering their will to fight.

skills.name: Courage Raze
skills.description: Increases the effectiveness of physical and magical damage to enemies for a while by blowing dark power into their weakened mind to reduce courage and by causing fear to deprive them of the will to defend against attacks.

skills.name: Physical Ravage
skills.description: Invades the bodies of enemies in the front line with chaotic energy passed on from the past, resulting in physical defense decrease for a fixed time.

skills.name: Magical Ravage
skills.description: Invade the mind of the enemies in the front line with curse energy made from hatred, resulting in magical defense decrease for a fixed time.
skills.study: Invade the mind of the enemies in the front line with curse energy made from the emotion of hatred, resulting in magical defense decrease for a fixed time.

skills.name: Red Flower
skills.description: Enhances the curse of blood to increase the magical damage when Flower skills of the Blood Line are used.

skills.name: Trap Booster
skills.description: Invokes a curse against traps to take more blood in order to increase magical damage when Trap skills of Blood Line are used.

skills.name: Blood Flower
skills.description: Throws a cursed bloody flower to cause damage to enemies.

skills.name: Bloody Trap
skills.description: Attaches a cursed bloody trap to an enemy. After a while the trap explodes, causing damage to the enemy.

skills.name: Death Flower
skills.description: Throws bloody flowers made of death to enemies. Enemies that touch the flowers get enormous damage, losing vitality to the deadly force in the flowers.

skills.name: Daze
skills.description: Delivers the powerful energy of anger on enemies. Enemies who fail to overcome the energy lose consciousness.

skills.name: Fog Sight
skills.description: Covers the eyes of enemies with bloody fog to reduce the range of distant attacks. You cannot use this skill for Monsters.
skills.study: Covers the eyes of enemies with a bloody fog to reduce the range of distant attacks. You cannot use this skill for Monsters.

skills.name: Illusion
skills.description: Covers Warlock's body with the curtain of chaos to disguise themselves as a character that is of a lower Lv to enemies. The curtain of chaos changes characters based on the brain waves of viewers so that the characters look different from viewer to viewer.

skills.name: Wrath Daze
skills.description: Explodes the emotion of anger suppressed inside, bursting forth the energy of anger to a number of enemies. Those who cannot tolerate the energy of anger will be stunned for awhile.
skills.study: Explodes the emotion from anger suppressed inside, bursting forth the energy of anger to a number of enemies. Those who cannot tolerate the energy of anger will be stunned for awhile.

skills.name: Shade Illusion
skills.description: Randomly transforms yourself into a character lower level than you, by using dark shadows made from the curse energy. Transformed targets will look different from viwer to viwer depends on the flow of curse energy.

skills.name: Blood Aim
skills.description: Causes strong obsession with blood and anger against enemies to absorb more vital forces when Vampire skills are used and to give more damage to enemies when Shadow skills are used.

skills.name: Vampire Touch
skills.description: The jealousy of ones health causes enemie's HP to be stolen for ones own vital force. This skill disregards the defensive power of enemies.
skills.study: The jealousy of ones health causes enemie's HP to be stolen for ones own vital force.. This skill disregards the defensive power of enemies.

skills.name: Shadow Armor
skills.description: Summons a shield of shadows around you, made from powerful anger, for a while. The shield will damage enemies nearby and disregards any defense.

skills.name: Scream Mask
skills.description: Covers one member of the party with a mask of horror to protect them from enemies by making enemies horrified. Enemies who are weak lose consciousness.

skills.name: Reflect
skills.description: Protects the Warlocks' body with anger energy for a while and reflects part of the magical damage to enemies.
skills.study: Protects the Warlocks' body with energy from anger for a while and reflects part of the magical damage to enemies regardless of their defensive power.

skills.name: Vampire Kiss
skills.description: The greed for vitality is met by taking enemies' vital force significantly to fill up HP. This skill disregards the defensive power of enemies.

skills.name: Dusk Armor
skills.description: Summons a shield of shadows, made from the anger at dusk, around yourself for a fixed time. The shield does damage enemies and ignores their defense for the time it is summoned.
skills.study: Summons a shield of shadows, made from the anger at dusk, around yourself for a fixed time. The shield does damage to enemies and ignores their defense for the time it is summoned.

skills.name: Advanced Reflect
skills.description: Burst out this anger energy by focusing the emotion of hatred towards enemy. This results in protection of yourself and other party members. This protection returns part of the damage dealt on party members and you for a fixed time.
skills.study: Burst out this anger energy by focusing the emotion of hatred all to the enemy, this results in protection of yourself and other party members. This protection returns part of the damage dealt on party members and you for a fixed time.

skills.name: Slumber
skills.description: Throws a slumber seed on enemies to make them sleep.

skills.name: Wheel Bind
skills.description: Blows horror to enemies to deprive them of the will to recover and to weaken the blessing of healing. Under panic state there will be a 4 second delay when HP potion is consumed.
skills.study: Blows horror to enemies to deprive them of the will to recover and to weaken the blessing of healing.

skills.name: Mirage
skills.description: Shows a mirage created from the horror of darkness to Monsters when they attack. Monsters stuck in the mirage reduce their hostility.

skills.name: Deep Slumber
skills.description: Spreads the powder of sleep made from a deep dark fantasy on enemies in the front line, causing enemies to sleep for a fixed time.

skills.name: Phantasma
skills.description: By using the powerful energy, it makes yourself look different by raising fear of the dark in the eyes of the monsters that are around you. Confused monsters will reduce their hostility toward the caster.
skills.study: Makes yourself look different by raising fear of the dark in the eyes of the monsters that are around you, by using the powerful energy of fear. Confused monsters will reduce their hostility toward the caster.

skills.name: Vibration
skills.description: Enhances the vibration of the harp. This skill increases magical damage when using skills of the Battle Chord Line.

skills.name: Echo
skills.description: Enhances the resonance of sound by using mana so that the range of skills of the Music Pleasure Line extends.

skills.name: Music Life
skills.description: Enhances the capability to dance or play the harp with passion for music to reduce the consumption of mana when skills for dance or harp-playing are used.

skills.name: Prism
skills.description: Creates the defense screen of the light by making various harp sounds pass through the heart. This increases the possibility to protect the harp-playing from enemies' attacks when skills of Music Pleasure Line are used.

skills.name: Horror Chord
skills.description: Creates horrible and painful sounds around enemies to damage them.

skills.name: Booming Chord
skills.description: Bursts rhythm energy created from adding mana to chords. Enemies exposed to the rhythm energy take damage.

skills.name: Mana Switch
skills.description: A chord energy made with various pitches is put onto a target around you. When the target damages an enemy, some part of the damage will be converted to mana and your MP will be recovered. This cannot used on yourself, and the effect of the skill is only applied when using a harp.

skills.name: Weird Chord
skills.description: Spreads horrible and terrifying chords around enemies to cause damage to multiple enemies.

skills.name: Booming Wave
skills.description: Converts the cumulated mana inside the body to sound energy, and greatly damages the enemies around you by bursting forth energy.

skills.name: Moving March
skills.description: Increases the speed of members' movement for a certain period of time by making party members march to the lively music.
skills.study: Increases the speed of members' movement by making party members march to the lively music.

skills.name: Guard Tambour
skills.description: Creates a defense screen of strong rhythm which absorbs the physical damage and protects party members by playing powerful music of survival. You cannot use the skill with other instrumental skills except for Moving March or Swing March of the Music Pleasure Line. The effect disappears along with other music when attacked or attacking.
skills.study: Creates a defense screen of strong rhythm which absorbs the physical damage and protects party members by playing powerful music of survival. You cannot use the skill with other instrumental skills except for Moving March or Swing March of the Music Pleasure Line. The effect disappears along with other music when attacked or attacking.

skills.name: Mana Tambour
skills.description: Creates a defense screen of soft rhythm which absorbs the magical damage and protects party members by playing soft music of endurance. You cannot use the skill with other instrumental skills except for Moving March or Swing March of Music Pleasure Line. The effect disappears along with other music when attacked or attacking.
skills.study: Creates a defense screen of soft rhythm which absorbs the magical damage and protects party members by playing soft music of endurance. You cannot use the skill with other instrumental skills except for Moving March or Swing March of Music Pleasure Line. The effect disappears along with other music when attacked or attacking.

skills.name: Hit March
skills.description: Increases the hit rate of party members nearby by playing sophisticated and calm music. You cannot use this skill with other instrumental skills except for Moving March or Swing March of the Music Pleasure Line. The effect disappears along with music grinding to a halt proportionally to an attack.

skills.name: Swing March
skills.description: Increases the movement speed of party members for a fixed time through fast and light music play.

skills.name: Holding Clamor
skills.description: Freezes enemies' movement temporarily by making clamorous sounds enough to give pain.

skills.name: Cure Melody
skills.description: "Randomly selects and cures a bad status among; power reduction, limit, and curse by playing emotional music for a member."
skills.study: "Randomly selects a party member and cures a bad status among; power reduction, limit, and curse by playing emotional music for a member."

skills.name: Temptation
skills.description: Plays music infatuating monsters to get friendly so that they attack other Monsters nearby for a while. This skill only works for regular monsters and regular party Monsters.

skills.name: Rave Melody
skills.description: Converts some amount of HP to MP by playing stormy music to create a mana storm inside your body.

skills.name: Patter Clamor
skills.description: Disables the movement of enemies exposed to the music temporarily, by making a sharp ripping sound around the target.

skills.name: Tuning Noise
skills.description: Damages your enemy by playing discordant music and suddenly turning it into loud noise. You can convert the damage of enemies into your MP through the wave. This skill disregards the defensive power of enemies.
skills.study: Damages your enemy by playing discordant music and suddenly turning it into loud noise You can convert the damage of enemies into your MP through the wave. This skill disregards the defensive power of enemies.

skills.name: Mana Cycle
skills.description: Through a powerful rhythm, you play a music that stimulates the target's mind. The stimulated target will recover a small amount of MP for a fixed duration.

skills.name: Noise
skills.description: Protects you from the attack of Monsters for a while by using the harp to create and spread noise around you.

skills.name: Mana Wind
skills.description: Plays sentimental music filled with your mana. A listener gets full of mana (Full MP charge), and a certain portion of the effect is transferred to two party members nearby.

skills.name: Discord Wave
skills.description: Removes Monsters' hostility toward their target by creating a big wave of discord around the target.

skills.name: Tuning Sound
skills.description: First a harmonious music is played, then all of a sudden loud and horrible music is played to deal damage to the enemy. The damage dealt on the enemy will be converted to your MP. This skill ignores the target's defense.
skills.study: First a harmonious music is played, then all of a sudden loud and horrible music is played to deal damage to an enemy. The damage dealt on the enemy will be converted to your MP. This skill ignores the target's defense.

skills.name: Mana Breeze
skills.description: Plays a music with your mana for all party members. Party members listening to the music will feel their body filled with mana, resulting in a fixed amount of MP recovery.

skills.name: Tripping
skills.description: After learning how to dance delightfulness, Bards extend the range of the effect when they dance to a delightful music. The skill works only when you use Dancing Concert Line skills.

skills.name: Screen Dance
skills.description: Helps you concentrate your mind on dancing so that you don't stop dancing even under attack. The skill works only when you use Dancing Concert Line skills.

skills.name: Dancing of Valor
skills.description: Increases party members' morale and short distance physical damage by expressing valor in dance. Cannot be used simultaneously with other skills, and the effect will disappear when attacked. This skill will only work when you are within the distance of the music play effect of another player's music play.

skills.name: Dancing of Magic
skills.description: Stimulates party members' mentality to enhance their offensive magic power by expressing delicate emotional change in dance. Cannot be used simultaneously with other skills, and the effect will disappear when attacked. This skill will only work when you are within the distance of the music play effect of another player's music.

skills.name: Dancing of Healing
skills.description: Comforts party members' bodies and souls, and increases the effect of healing by expressing calm and oppressed emotions in dance. Cannot be used simultaneously with other skills, and the effect will disappear when attacked. This skill will only work when you are within the distance of the music play effect of another player's music.

skills.name: Dancing of Mana
skills.description: Brightens party members' feelings by expressing vitality of life in dance, and saves MP when using it. Cannot be used simultaneously with other skills, and the effect will disappear when attacked. This skill will only work when you are within the distance of the music play effect of another player's music.

skills.name: Dancing of Fight
skills.description: Increases the morale of party members around by dancing with combative spirit, increasing the physical damage of short distance attacks. Cannot be used simultaneously with other skills, and the effect will disappear when attacked. This skill will only work when you are within the distance of the music play effect of another player's music play.

skills.name: Dancing of Wizardry
skills.description: Stimulating the mind of party members by dancing a with powerful emotional stream of air, increasing the damage of magical attacks. Cannot be used simultaneously with other skills, and the effect will disappear when attacked. This skill will only work when you are within the distance of the music play effect of another player's music.

skills.name: Heavenly Rage
skills.description: Increases your offensive power when using Trial Cross, Justice Cross and other skills in Sacrifice Line by demonstrating furious power to desecrater.

skills.name: Trial Cross
skills.description: Injures enemies and damages them with the Cross where the Christ suffered.

skills.name: Healing
skills.description: Restores HP of a subject by giving a low level healing breath.

skills.name: Reverse
skills.description: Resurrects a dead member by praying and bringing the soul back to the body.

skills.name: Innocent
skills.description: Reduces the effect of bad status except faint and freeze and cures 2 randomly. Also removes a cursed Bloody Trap by praying for purification of a subject.

skills.name: Justice Cross
skills.description: Injures enemies on the front line with a Cross with pain created from the force of God's justice so that enemies get magical damage.

skills.name: Healing Breath
skills.description: Injects strong healing breath to a member to recover his HP significantly.

skills.name: Grad Reverse
skills.description: Resurrects a dead member with a higher level by praying and bringing the soul back into the cold body.

skills.name: Integrity
skills.description: Greatly reduce the influence of all the bad status on party members excluding stun and petrify, through the pray of cure springing up from deep faith. The skill also randomly cures 2 bad status. Bloody trap with curse energy is also removed.

skills.name: Faith
skills.description: Increases healing power with smaller consumption of mana when using an HP healing skill by improving healing through faith. This skill increases defensive power against bad status in Curse Line and only works when Clerics wear a robe and a rod.

skills.name: Over Healing
skills.description: Injures enemies with a healing power surpassing enemies' vitality. Enemies get damaged if they fail to overcome the sacred power. This skill disregards the defensive power of enemies.

skills.name: Glut Healing
skills.description: Deals great damage to enemies in the front line by infusing healing power surpassing enemies' vitality. This skill disregards the defensive power of enemies.

skills.name: Group Healing
skills.description: Generates low level healing breath at multiple locations simultaneously to restore party members' HP.

skills.name: Healing Division
skills.description: Spreads the healing power widely so that party members with low HP can automatically recover. The healing power is transferred to party members nearby, increasing their HP all together.

skills.name: Healing Cycle
skills.description: Restores HP of a specific member repeatedly little by little for a certain time by praying for the member.

skills.name: Group Healing Breath
skills.description: Heals the HP of yourself and party members through a powerful cure wind made to put the pain asleep in the body.

skills.name: Healing Favor
skills.description: Distributes the powerful energy of cures by automatically finding a party member with low HP. The energy of cure is transferred to other nearby party members, healing their HP as well.

skills.name: Healing Orbit
skills.description: With strong friendship and the ability of cure, it is amplified to recover small amounts of HP of yourself and party members for a fixed duration.

skills.name: Bless Spell
skills.description: Creates a sacred wave protecting party members including yourself from any physical and magical attack by repeating the prayer of joy God taught you for your sincere faith.

skills.name: Recovery
skills.description: Recovers HP of a specific member by a certain percentage by praying for a blessing of recovery.

skills.name: Recovery Division
skills.description: Shares a certain amount of healing power regularly with the member with the lowest HP for a certain time by praying for recovery.

skills.name: Group Recovery
skills.description: Recovers HP of all party members at once by using rapid healing power generated from prayer for saving a failing life.

skills.name: Holy Recovery
skills.description: Recovers the HP of the target by praying a grace for holy cure of the pain the target is in.

skills.name: Group Reverse
skills.description: Resurrects party members within a certain range by praying for revival.

skills.name: Reverse Oblation
skills.description: A soul resurrect by sacrificing some parts of the deal soul. A resurrected lose offensive power for a certain period of time, but has increased defensive power. When it is returning to its normal state, it loses great amount of HP and MP.

skills.name: Charity
skills.description: Increases the effect of skills such as Force Blessing, Force Deity, Mental Blessing and Mental Deity by practicing God's teaching and offering mercy to people. This skill also enhances defensive power against bad-status attacks of Weakening Line. It works only when you wear light armor and a Cleric rod.
skills.study: Increases the effect of skills such as Force Blessing, Force Deity, Mental Blessing and Mental Deity by practicing God's teaching and offering mercy to people. This skill also enhances defensive power against bad-status attacks of Weakening Line. It works only when you wear light armor and a Cleric rod.

skills.name: Glory Armor
skills.description: Increases physical defensive power by covering your body with brilliant energy from God's glory. This skill only works when you wear light armor and Cleric rod.
skills.study: Increases physical defensive power by covering your body with brilliant energy from God's glory. This skill only works when you wear light armor and a Cleric rod.

skills.name: Favor Armor
skills.description: Increases magical defensive power by covering your body with sacred energy from God's blessing. This skill only works when you wear light armor Cleric rod.
skills.study: Increases magical defensive power by covering your body with sacred energy from God's blessing. This skill only works when you wear light armor and a Cleric rod.

skills.name: Offering
skills.description: Injures enemies nearby with destructive power given by God in return for your vitality as a sacrifice. You cannot use this skill when your vitality is smaller than the required vitality level as a sacrifice.
skills.study: Injures enemies nearby with destructive power given by God in return for vitality as a sacrifice. You cannot use this skill when your vitality is smaller than the required vitality level as a sacrifice.

skills.name: Pure Offering
skills.description: Deals great damage to enemies nearby through a powerful destructive force gained in return for your vitality as a sacrifce. You cannot use the skill when your vitality is smaller than the required vitality level as a sacrifice.

skills.name: Holy Word
skills.description: By speaking God's words, protects members from bad status except faint and feeze for a certain period of time.

skills.name: Heaven Flash
skills.description: Puts enemies in a flash trap so that they cannot move.

skills.name: Holy Spell
skills.description: Temporarily protects party members from all bad status attacks excluding stun and petrify, by infusing the energy of heaven through the holy spell into the party members..

skills.name: Heaven Glare
skills.description: Bind many enemies so that they can't move by using a trap made from the powerful light of heaven.
skills.study: Bind many enemies so that they can't move by using a trap made from the powerful light of heaven

skills.name: Force Blessing
skills.description: Enhances the power of a subject for a while by praying for the strength of the subject. You cannot use the skill on yourself.

skills.name: Mental Blessing
skills.description: Enhances the intelligent power of a subject for a while by praying for the wisdom of the subject. You cannot use the skill on yourself.

skills.name: Body Blessing
skills.description: Increases the physical defensive power of a subject for a while by praying.

skills.name: Soul Blessing
skills.description: Increases the magical defensive power of a subject for a while by praying.

skills.name: Force Deity
skills.description: Increases the strength of a subject for a while by praying for God's power for the subject. You cannot use the skill on yourself.

skills.name: Mental Deity
skills.description: Greatly increases the target's intelligence for a fixed time by infusing holy mind of the heaven. You cannot use the skill on yourself.

skills.name: Body Deity
skills.description: Greatly increases the target's physical defense power for a fixed time by covering the target in solid skin given by God through prayer.
